files.description: Original EHI export documentation PDF (2023-11-16, 7 pages). Describes the per-patient ZIP export format including CSV files, EMN encounter PDFs, CCDA, and documents. This is the version registered at CHPL.

Updated EHI export documentation PDF (2025, 8 pages). Supersedes the 2023 version with expanded SDOH data classes, configuration-dependent notes, and DSI feedback coverage. Found on the compliance hub page linked from the original PDF.

Excel data dictionary with 16 sheets and 730 field definitions covering all CSV exports, EMN PDF fields, and DSI feedback. Each field has name, description, and optional notes. Primary computable artifact for understanding the export schema.

Nextech compliance hub page listing EHI export documentation for all Nextech products. Contains download links for Select/NexCloud, Nextech EHR (ICP), and SRSPro documentation. Saved as reference for navigation reproducibility.
Bun TypeScript script that extracts the XLSX data dictionary into queryable JSON. Parses all 16 sheets, extracts field definitions, and produces data-dictionary.json and extraction-summary.json.

Complete extracted data dictionary in JSON format. Contains all 16 entities with 730 field definitions including field name, description, note, export format, and derived filename. Primary queryable artifact for downstream analysis.
Extraction accounting: 16 sheets discovered, 16 parsed, 0 failures. Per-entity field counts and totals.
Enrichment documentation: run commands, input boundary, output files, known parsing limitations.
